name.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for a staff member's name.

role.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for a staff member's role: pastor, elder or staff.

photo.description: The label of the field for the address of a staff member's photo.

email.description: The label of the field for a staff member's email address.

phone.description: The label of the field for a staff member's phone number.

bio.description: The label of the rich text editor for a staff member's bio in full.
